title: NanoSleep: A Parameter-Efficient Hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network for Single-Channel Sleep Stage Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.18571v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sleep stage classification from single-channel electroencephalography (EEG) is essential for wearable and home-based sleep monitoring. However, many deep learning models achieve high accuracy at the cost of large model sizes, which limits their deployment on resource-constrained devices. In this work, we present NanoSleep, a compact hybrid temporal convolutional network for automatic sleep stage classification. NanoSleep combines a learnable Sinc-convolutional front end, a dual-branch feature extractor that fuses multi-scale temporal and spectral representations, a gated dilated temporal convolutional backbone with channel recalibration, and a conditional random field for sequence-level decoding. We further employ a weighted calibrated focal loss to address class imbalance. We evaluate NanoSleep on the Sleep-EDF and Sleep-EDF-Expanded datasets using subject-wise cross-validation. translated_title: NanoSleep：一种面向单通道睡眠阶段分类的参数高效混合时间卷积网络
translated_abstract: 摘要：基于单通道脑电图（EEG）的睡眠阶段分类对于可穿戴设备和居家睡眠监测至关重要。然而，许多深度学习模型以较大的模型规模换取高精度，这限制了它们在资源受限设备上的部署。在本研究中，我们提出了NanoSleep，一种紧凑的混合时间卷积网络，用于自动睡眠阶段分类。NanoSleep结合了可学习的Sinc卷积前端、融合多尺度时间和频谱表示的双分支特征提取器、带有通道重校准的门控膨胀时间卷积主干网络，以及用于序列级解码的条件随机场。我们进一步采用加权校准焦点损失来解决类别不平衡问题。我们在Sleep-EDF和Sleep-EDF-Expanded数据集上使用受试者交叉验证评估了NanoSleep。所提出的模型持续优于六种代表性方法。
tldr: NanoSleep通过紧凑的混合时间卷积架构，在保持高分类精度的同时大幅降低模型参数，实现了资源受限设备上的高效单通道睡眠阶段分类。
en_tdlr: NanoSleep achieves efficient single-channel sleep stage classification on resource-constrained devices by using a compact hybrid temporal convolutional architecture that maintains high accuracy while significantly reducing model parameters.
